On Fig. 4.1, sketch the new trace shown on the screen of the c.r.o.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
The mass of liquid leaving the tube per unit time is $6.7 \text{g s}^{-1}$. The tube has an internal cross-sectional area of $13 \text{cm}^{2}$. The density of the liquid is $0.79 \text{g cm}^{-3}$.

Calculate the time taken for the liquid to move from level A to level B.
